next_action: Réduire uniquement le coût du déchiffrement Noise Android, puis vérifier le gain end-to-end par A/B sous les mêmes garde-fous, sans changer le protocole.

interpretation.clock_domains: No cross-clock timestamps subtracted or aligned; only local durations and a causal envelope.
interpretation.historical_baseline: PR34 values are historical, not a direct baseline against this new APK.
interpretation.overlap: Host/Android overlays are not additive. RemoteBuffer copy is nested in handler execution.
interpretation.largest_individually_isolated_median: Android snow read_message/decrypt; 737.853 ms median over the three valid runs.
interpretation.second_isolated_group: Android receive polling plus handler-completion delay; 647.456 ms median. Inter-PUT polling overlaps host queue and transport residual.
interpretation.transport: Blocking record reads and the outside-Android-core envelope are not pure USB times. A unique global physical transport-vs-polling cause is not proven.
interpretation.observer_effect: Post-run exports excluded. Collector storage <=1.5 MiB per side plus post-run snapshots. Total probe overhead not independently qualified; wall intervals include instrumentation/preemption.

issues.detail: Initial READY wait 20 s expired before any job; same connection reached READY naturally around 27 s. No PhoneBoost timeout changed.
Startup 1-byte readiness PUT explicitly accounted outside the 17 job PUTs; timestamp ordering and correlation checked.
Reap owned completed child in the runner; run1 retained, only run2/run3 continued.
Samsung ignored cmd power set-mode 0; witness command not reached, exit2, original ON verified by fresh Health. Automatic successful toggling not physically qualified.
